    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp only for mechanical accessor call-site updates.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not alter the kernel public C API, library boundary, or options; updates call sites inside bitcoinkernel.cpp."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches policy and txmempool files strictly via mechanical member-to-method updates.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not change mempool policy, validation rules, or acceptance logic, only migrating call sites to observer methods."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/node/miner.cpp and src/rpc/mining.cpp only via mechanical call-site updates.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Block assembly and mining interfaces are unaffected beyond mechanical observer replacements."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/node/txdownloadman_impl.cpp solely for mechanical accessor migration.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "P2P protocol handling, message processing, and network transport remain completely unchanged."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches RPC handlers only to replace direct transaction field accesses with observer calls.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "RPC endpoints and their returned JSON data formats are unaffected."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches unit tests, benchmarks, and fuzz targets solely to migrate member accesses.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "No changes to the test frameworks, runners, or test infrastructure itself."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Adds a clang-tidy check in contrib/devtools/bitcoin-tidy solely to automate this PR's call-site migration.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The custom clang-tidy check is an implementation tool for executing the refactor rather than a general tool for operators or contributors."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches utility files (such as src/common/bloom.cpp) only via mechanical call-site replacement.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Common utilities and logging infrastructure are not altered."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the Validation label and alters core consensus data types in src/primitives/transaction.h.",
      "band": "P4",
      "score": 0.15,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Encapsulates CTransaction data members behind observer methods without modifying consensus behavior. While intended to allow CTransaction to become a regular value type and facilitate future interface segregation, it is an internal structural refactoring that does not fix bugs, enhance performance, or retire an active consensus hazard."
    },
